what: A/B of the sm89 operator pack on the TILED rendering path (2K 2560x1440, 85 frames, 2 spatial tiles, RTX 4090 D, container torch 2.13.0+cu130)
method: same comfyui/nodes.py pipeline call via render_tiled; arm B sets FS89_FP8='' FS89_FUSED_ROPE=0 FS89_FUSED_ADALN=0 before import. LCSA backend is 'triton' (zero-compile stub) in BOTH arms, so the delta isolates FP8 linears + fused RoPE + fused AdaLN.
notes: Untiled headline on this machine class: 1.17-1.30x — the tiled delta is the same within run-to-run drift.
Ops are class-level forward rebinding + weight conversion, orthogonal to canvas slicing: every tile runs the fused kernels.
FP8 also cuts peak VRAM (18.98 vs 20.28 GiB) — smaller activations in the linears.
